intro: Misha is the loyal bear companion of Rexxar, the Champion of the Horde. Rescued as an orphaned cub, she wanders Kalimdor faithfully at the Mok'nathal beastmaster's side.

p: Rexxar discovered Misha as an orphaned cub beside her slain mother in the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas. Recognizing a kindred solitary spirit, the wandering Mok'nathal adopted her and gave her a name. Together they ventured north into the arid wilds of Desolace, forging a fierce, protective partnership that has weathered countless wildernesses and bloody battles.

Misha is far more than a tame pet; she is a seasoned warrior. She fought alongside Rexxar in the brutal conflict against Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore at Theramore Isle, helping ensure the young Horde's survival. When not in battle, her keen senses and strength serve as an extension of Rexxar's will, even carrying fallen allies such as the orc Byrok back to Orgrimmar.

Currently, travelers venturing along the long tracks through the Stonetalon Mountains, Desolace, and Feralas can spot Misha padding quietly beside Rexxar. Though fierce enough to tear apart any predator foolish enough to threaten them, she remains Rexxar's steadfast anchor in an otherwise untrustworthy world.
